text: Gardening is a rewarding activity that not only provides fresh produce but also fosters a connection with nature. Watering is the initial step in gardening, as it helps to keep plants healthy and hydrated. Proper watering techniques are crucial for preventing over-watering and ensuring that plants receive the right amount of moisture. Pruning, on the other hand, is the next important step, as it encourages new growth and helps maintain the shape and structure of the plants. Regular pruning also aids in the removal of dead or diseased parts, reducing the risk of disease and pests. By following these two essential steps, gardeners can enjoy a thriving and productive garden.
